variants.preserve: Round sage-green hood, peach neck cloth, cream tunic, green outer clothing, brown satchel and boots; green forest scene.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the small protagonist in image 1. Image 2 is the user's exact FIRST A image and the authoritative character reference.
The previous attempt was rejected for losing pixel-art style. Do not use its smooth, highly rendered face or detailed stitching style. Recreate the protagonist using the SAME visible pixel construction as the small keeper in image 2: match A's face design, brown hair shapes, head-to-body anatomy, limb shapes, cloth block shading, outline thickness and effective pixel size. This is a faithful sprite-style translation of A's keeper into the target scene, not a new anime interpretation.
FACE: copy A's restrained small block-shaped dark eyes, simple peach skin planes, tiny block blush, sparse mouth/nose suggestion and grouped brown fringe. No large glossy eyes, iris rendering, curved eyelash lines, smooth skin gradients or finely modeled nose/lips. Keep the face charming by its original pixel shapes.
CLOTHES: match A's hood, cloak and tunic construction with deliberate grouped pixel blocks: folded hood rim, collar, neck cloth, sleeves, hanging hem, leather bag/strap and boots. Use a small number of discrete shades per material. The detail should be A's readable fold and edge shapes; no fine woven textures, continuous seam lines, decorative stitching, miniature buckles everywhere, painterly brushstrokes or smooth highlights.
PIXEL LANGUAGE: strong intentional stepped silhouette at the SAME scale as A; visible rectangular color clusters, crisp unblended edges, sparse selective outlines. No anti-aliased cartoon contours, no gradient airbrushing, no subpixel detailing, no blur or sharpen-filter treatment. Do not add a fake pixel grid over a smooth drawing.
Preserve the target character's small footprint, feet position, overall body height and lantern-carrying pose; do not enlarge the character or its head to manufacture detail. Keep A's short clearly separated legs and draping tunic. Both character and environment must look made from the same pixel language.
Keep all non-character content of image 1 as closely unchanged as possible: full landscape frame, cottage, roof, doors/windows, pond, waterfall, dock, flowers, beds, lamps, roads, trees and lighting. Same perspective, no zoom and no crop. Keep the original warm handheld lantern, with its brass frame and glass represented by a few blocky pixels, as in A.
One full scene. No text, labels, inset portrait, comparison panels, border or watermark. Prioritize matching image 2 over inventing additional detail.
B variant: retain the sage/olive GREEN rounded hood, peach neck cloth, cream tunic, green outer cloth, brown leather bag and boots. The face and body should look like A's actual keeper wearing B's outfit. Keep the green forest and rounded moss-roof cottage unchanged.
